units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 27:9">Ex. R. s. 27</cite> (play on <he>זר</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 6:1">Prov. VI, 1</cite>) <he>אתה הכנסת עצמך לז׳ וכ׳</he> thou (by assuming an office) hast placed thyself in the arena &c.
<cite ref="Proverbs 6:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אני ואתה עומדים בז׳</he> we two stand in the arena (combatting each other).
